name: Brilliant Barrier
body:
School evocation [force]; Level cleric 4, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action
Components V, S, M/DF (a small sheet of clear thin crystal)

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. plus 40 ft./level)
Area up to a 5-ft.-square per caster level
Duration 1 minute
Saving Throw Reflex partial (see below); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You conjure a barrier of shimmering force similar to a wall of force spell. The brilliant barrier molds to fit any shape of a cavern, portal, or hull breach and seals off any spaces in between so long as your caster level is sufficient to cover the area. A brilliant barrier has hardness 20 and 10 hp per caster level.
